function.name: reqmap_init
function.description: First-use bootstrap: scaffold requirements/ and .reqmapignore if missing, draft requirements from existing code/prose, build the lock and map, and print guided next steps. Idempotent — safe to re-run; never clobbers an existing .reqmapignore. Run once per repo to get started.

root.description: Repo root where requirements/ lives; defaults to the current directory.

wipe.description: Hard-reset: delete all non-generated requirements and strip membership tags from source files before re-extracting.

no_site.description: Skip the final site step (scaffolding docs/architecture.html).

function.name: reqmap_new
function.description: Scaffold a new blank requirement from the built-in template. Use --from-todo and --id together to pre-fill from a TODO.md item instead.

root.description: Repo root where requirements/ lives; defaults to the current directory.

id.description: Requirement ID in AREA-NAME-NNN format (e.g. AUTH-LOGIN-001). Required when using --from-todo.

from_todo.description: Scaffold the requirement from a TODO.md item matched by this name (use with --id; add --mark-done to flip the item to [x]).

mark_done.description: Also flip the matched TODO.md item to [x] (off by default). Only used with --from-todo.

function.name: reqmap_gate
function.description: Run the commit/CI gate (report-only): verify every code tag resolves to a real requirement, every confirmed requirement has at least one implements: member, and drift has not been introduced since the last sync. Exits non-zero on link-sync errors only (drift and test-link integrity are warnings). Never touches _reqlock.json. Run before every commit and in CI.

root.description: Repo root where requirements/ lives; defaults to the current directory.

strict.description: Promote drift and test-link integrity warnings to errors. Useful in CI when all requirements are confirmed.

json.description: Emit structured JSON output instead of human-readable text.

since.description: Scope the gate to requirements whose member files changed since this git ref (e.g. 'main', 'HEAD~1').

function.name: reqmap_sync
function.description: Rescan code members, advance the drift baseline, and regenerate the map in one step (a committed _findings.md is refreshed too). Run after editing requirement files or tagging new code members. Use --accept-drift when a confirmed or implemented contract changed.

root.description: Repo root where requirements/ lives; defaults to the current directory.

accept_drift.description: Explicitly advance the baseline when a confirmed or implemented contract changed. Required when those contracts differ from the lock; sync exits non-zero without it.

strict.description: Promote drift and test-link integrity from warn to error.

function.name: reqmap_next
function.description: Show what to do next: a prioritized, actionable list of risk buckets (Orphans, Needs tests, Needs intent review, Drafts to review). Read-only, always exits 0. The best follow-up command to run after any action.

root.description: Repo root where requirements/ lives; defaults to the current directory.

show_all.description: Expand all buckets to show every item instead of just the top few.

function.name: reqmap_show
function.description: Print a consolidated dossier for one requirement: header, intent, Contract bullets, dependencies in both directions, code members grouped by role with file:line, open Verify intent questions, and risk signals. Answers 'what does this do / where is X' in one command. Read-only.

root.description: Repo root where requirements/ lives; defaults to the current directory.

function.name: reqmap_dupes
function.description: Flag requirement pairs whose contracts overlap (TF-IDF cosine similarity), so a divergent re-implementation is caught before it lands. Read-only, advisory — a human decides if a flagged pair is a real duplicate.

root.description: Repo root where requirements/ lives; defaults to the current directory.

threshold.description: Cosine similarity cutoff in (0,1] for reporting a pair (default 0.35). Lower = more pairs flagged.

function.name: reqmap_search
function.description: Rank requirements by lexical relevance to a free-text query (same TF-IDF cosine as dupes, reused). Read-only. Prints each hit's score, and says so explicitly when nothing clears the relevance floor rather than showing a spurious top result. Lexical, not synonym-aware.

root.description: Repo root where requirements/ lives; defaults to the current directory.

top.description: Maximum number of ranked matches to show (default 5).

function.name: reqmap_draft
function.description: Draft one requirement per untagged file (code and prose). Input is existing untagged source code and Markdown. Emits draft requirements — never confirmed. After drafting, run gate and report the result. Remind the user to review and confirm the real ones.

root.description: Repo root where requirements/ lives; defaults to the current directory.

function.name: reqmap_confirm
function.description: Mark a reviewed requirement as confirmed — the human sign-off step. Flips status to confirmed in the frontmatter. The engine refuses if the requirement has no implements: member (a confirmed requirement must point to code). Run sync after confirming.

root.description: Repo root where requirements/ lives; defaults to the current directory.

function.name: reqmap_clarify
function.description: Ask what a requirement has not answered yet: vague terms with no threshold, numbers with no unit, unbounded quantities, clauses with no case, a missing failure path. Read-only, always exit 0, never a gate rule. Run it before implementing so the ambiguity is resolved in the requirement, not guessed in code.

root.description: Repo root where requirements/ lives; defaults to the current directory.

as_json.description: Emit the questions as JSON for an agent to answer.

function.name: reqmap_implement
function.description: Emit the brief for implementing one requirement in code: its obligations, its cases, the exact tags the new code must carry, where similar code already lives, and the command that proves the work landed. Writes no code and no file.

root.description: Repo root where requirements/ lives; defaults to the current directory.

as_json.description: Emit the brief as JSON for a coding agent.

function.name: reqmap_retire
function.description: Take a requirement out of service. Prints the blast radius first — dependents, children, members, and the files where it was the only tagged requirement. Refuses while dependents exist unless --force. Deprecates by default (reversible); --delete also removes the block, its lock entries and its membership tags, never a function body. Nothing is written without --apply.

root.description: Repo root where requirements/ lives; defaults to the current directory.

delete.description: Remove the requirement outright instead of marking it deprecated.

do_apply.description: Actually perform the retirement; without it nothing is written.

force.description: Proceed despite dependents, or on a dirty working tree.

as_json.description: Emit the plan (and what was applied) as JSON.

function.name: reqmap_review
function.description: Emit a JSON review plan (intent, contract, acceptance criteria, structural anchors) for all requirements or one. Used as an AI feed for semantic quality review. Read-only.

root.description: Repo root where requirements/ lives; defaults to the current directory.

function.name: reqmap_translate
function.description: Manual, opt-in: detect the corpus's majority language (per-file `lang:` frontmatter override honored first), then cache a `claude -p` translation of every requirement written in that language into requirements/_i18n/<target>.json. A structural-fidelity check (backticked spans, numbers, heading/bullet markers) gates every cache write; a missing `claude` CLI, a timeout, or a failed check skips that entry with a warning instead of aborting. `map`/`export` inline the cache into the graph read-only, with no `claude` call of their own — this command is the ONLY way a `claude` subprocess runs; it is never invoked by gate/sync/lint/map or the pre-commit hook.

root.description: Repo root where requirements/ lives; defaults to the current directory.

translate_to.description: Target locale, 'ro' or 'en' (default: the other of the two from the detected corpus majority).

function.name: reqmap_design
function.description: Advisory design review of the repo's code (Python via ast; JS/TS, C/C++, Java, C#, Go, Rust and other brace languages via heuristics): the four OOP pillars plus house standards. encapsulation (module state written from functions, long parameter lists, data clumps), abstraction (long or deeply nested functions, prefix families), inheritance (unrelated classes sharing methods, duplicated method bodies) and polymorphism (isinstance chains, equality switches), standards (file and line length, public definitions without a docstring, definitions per file). Read-only, exit 0, never part of the gate; every threshold is tunable in requirements/_config.json.

root.description: Repo root where requirements/ lives; defaults to the current directory.

json.description: Emit the findings as a JSON object {files, findings[]}.

function.name: reqmap_suggest_verifies
function.description: Propose `# verifies: <id>#CASE-N` tags for tests already named after the criterion they check (e.g. `test_ac3_...`), so per-criterion coverage can be adopted on an existing corpus. Read-only; --apply writes the tags.

root.description: Repo root where requirements/ lives; defaults to the current directory.

apply.description: Write the proposed tags into the test files (ambiguous matches are never written).
